instruction: To improve Chrome's rendering performance on my system, please enable the 'enable-gpu-rasterization' experiment flag.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling GPU rasterization experiment for better performance. Uses custom metric function with subset checking.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_enabled_experiments (chrome.py:319) properly reads Chrome's Local State file and extracts the enabled_labs_experiments list.

Metric logic is correct: The custom metric function uses subset checking (line 22: 'required_names.issubset(enabled_names)') to verify that the required experiment is enabled while allowing additional experiments.
Instruction coverage is complete: The evaluator checks for the presence of 'enable-gpu-rasterization' experiment as required by the instruction.
Expected value is semantically correct: The rule correctly specifies the experiment name 'enable-gpu-rasterization' that needs to be enabled.
Postconfig is appropriate: Restarting Chrome ensures that the experiment flag setting is properly persisted and can be verified.
The subset checking logic correctly interprets the instruction 'enable the flag' (not 'ONLY enable this flag'), allowing users to have other experiments enabled simultaneously.
